questions.stem: 為了節省紙張、保護森林，政府鼓勵民眾用電子發票取代紙本收據。
questions.answer: To save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic ones.
accepted_answers: In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages the public to use e-invoices instead of paper receipts.
The government encourages people to replace paper receipts with e-invoices in order to save paper and protect forests.

questions.stem: 政府也提供免費的應用程式（app），好讓民眾查看和管理這些發票。
questions.answer: The government also provides a free app so that people can check and manage these electronic receipts.
accepted_answers: The government has also launched a free app so that the public can view and manage these e-invoices.
The government also offers a free app so that people can check and organize their electronic invoices.

1.explanation_zh: 「為了…」表目的，句首用不定詞 To + 原形動詞（或 In order to），後面加逗號再接主要子句；也可以把目的放到句尾。「節省紙張、保護森林」是兩個並列的目的，to save paper and (to) protect forests 形式要一致（平行結構）；paper 指紙張時不可數。「鼓勵民眾…」是 encourage + 受詞 + to VR。「用 A 取代 B」是 replace B with A、use A instead of B 或 use A to replace B；電子發票可以寫 e-invoices、electronic invoices 或 electronic receipts（electronic ones）。
evidence: 為了節省紙張、保護森林
用電子發票取代紙本收據
1.strategy_zh: 目的放句首時想 To VR …, S + V；並列的動作用 and 連接、形式一致。
hints: 切成四段：為了節省紙張／保護森林／政府鼓勵民眾／用電子發票取代紙本收據
標的詞彙：save（節省）、protect（保護）、forest（森林）、encourage（鼓勵）、replace（取代）、receipt（收據）
句型框架：To VR₁ … and VR₂ …, S + encourage + O + to replace B with A

2.explanation_zh: 「政府也提供…，好讓民眾…」：前半句主詞是政府（the government 是單數，動詞加 s：provides；「也」是 also），「應用程式」是可數名詞，單數要加 a：a free app。後半句表目的而且主詞換成民眾，用 so that + people + can + 原形動詞。「查看和管理」是 can 後面並列的兩個動作，用 and 連接、都用原形：check and manage（平行結構），兩個動詞共用受詞 these electronic receipts（these e-invoices），「這些發票」指上一句的電子發票。
evidence: 政府也提供免費的應用程式（app）
好讓民眾查看和管理這些發票
2.strategy_zh: 目的子句的主詞和主要子句不同時，用 so that + S + can …；同一個助動詞後面並列的動詞形式要一致。
hints: 切成四段：政府也提供免費的應用程式（app）／好讓民眾／查看和管理／這些發票
標的詞彙：government（政府）、provide（提供，也可用 offer）、free（免費的）、check（查看）、manage（管理）、receipt（收據；發票也可寫 invoice）
句型框架：S + also + provides + O + so that + S + can + VR₁ and VR₂ + O

references: To save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic ones.
In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages the public to use e-invoices instead of paper receipts.

traps.literal_error: To save paper and protecting forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic ones.
traps.explanation_zh: 平行結構：to save … and (to) protect …，第二個動作也用原形，不要寫成 protecting。

traps.zh: 用電子發票取代紙本收據
traps.literal_error: To save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people use e-invoices replace paper receipts.
traps.explanation_zh: 照中文語序把「用」「取代」兩個動詞並排不合英文；要寫 replace paper receipts with e-invoices、use e-invoices instead of paper receipts 或 use e-invoices to replace paper receipts。

1.restructuring_zh: 「用電子發票取代紙本收據」不能照中文把「用」「取代」兩個動詞並排：英文改成 replace paper receipts with e-invoices（被取代的紙本收據放在 replace 後面），或 use e-invoices instead of paper receipts。

common_errors.explanation_zh: app 是可數名詞，單數前面要有冠詞 a。
「好讓…」表目的，用 so that + 子句；let 是使役動詞，不能用來連接兩個子句。
「好讓＋另一個主詞＋能…」用 so that + 子句；in order to 後面只能接原形動詞，不能接主詞。
平行結構：can 後面兩個並列的動詞都用原形，形式要一致。
「發票」是消費的憑證 invoice／receipt；bill 多指帳單。

traps.literal_error: The government also provides a free app, let people check and manage these invoices.
traps.explanation_zh: 「好讓」照字面譯成 let 會把兩個子句硬接在一起；表目的要用 so that + people + can …。

traps.literal_error: The government also provides a free app so that people can check and managing these invoices.
traps.explanation_zh: 並列的兩個動作都接在 can 後面，都用原形：check and manage（平行結構）。

1.translation: In order to save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to replace paper receipts with electronic invoices.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了……」用 in order to V 表目的放句首；「鼓勵民眾做某事」用 encourage sb to V；「用 A 取代 B」用 replace B with A，所以是 replace paper receipts with electronic invoices（不可寫反）；電子發票在台灣的通行英文是 e-invoice／electronic invoice。

2.translation: The government also provides a free app so that people can check and manage these invoices.
2.explanation_zh: 「好讓民眾……」是目的，用 so that + 主詞 + can；「查看和管理」譯 check and manage（view 也可）；「這些發票」接上一句，用 these invoices。

issues_zh: （題目用語小建議，不影響判定）台灣一般說「用電子發票取代紙本發票」，中文題目把「電子發票」和「紙本收據」對比，發票、收據混用略不精確；參考譯文用 paper receipts 對 e-invoices 仍通順。

1.translation: To save paper and protect forests, the government encourages people to use electronic invoices instead of paper receipts.
1.explanation_zh: 「為了節省紙張、保護森林」是目的，用不定詞片語 To save paper and protect forests 放句首；「鼓勵民眾……」用 encourage + 受詞 + to V；「用電子發票取代紙本收據」可譯成 use electronic invoices instead of paper receipts。「發票」在台灣常說 invoice，「收據」用 receipt，兩者各自對應。

2.translation: The government also provides a free app so that people can check and manage these invoices.
2.explanation_zh: 「好讓民眾查看和管理這些發票」表示目的，用 so that + 子句（people can check and manage these invoices）；「免費的應用程式」用 a free app；「也提供」放在 also provides，副詞位置在 be 動詞之後、一般動詞之前。
